gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-anek-latin: Anek Latin is a plain sans with lowercase climbing nearly to cap height, its letters held open. And Wallpoet is the one to make a statement, bold and smooth-curved, while Anek Latin does the steady talking.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-anek-malayalam: Anek Malayalam hugs cap height with its lowercase, curve tips left open. Paragraph after paragraph it moves along cleanly and contemporary, a quiet counterweight to the loud Wallpoet above.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-anek-odia: Anek Odia reads with open, unlatched rounds and capitals barely above the lowercase. Anek Odia is built for dependable, clean text, whereas Wallpoet is built to grab attention with bold, smooth curves.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-anek-tamil: Wallpoet is all bold command, with high-rising lowercase and smooth curves. Anek Tamil, a sans-serif built from large round bowls and half-unwrapped curves, gives paragraphs a modern, unhurried flow.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-anek-telugu: Loud up top, friendly below: Anek Telugu, a plain sans, runs on wide, tall bowls and unsealed rounds. But Wallpoet is the one built to command, while the body gets on with being read.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-anuphan: Wallpoet commands attention, its lowercase rising high over smooth curves. Anuphan, a plain sans of large round bowls and open curves, does the opposite job, staying clean and unfussy.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-arimo: Wallpoet is a bold display face with smooth curves and high-rising lowercase. Arimo, a plain sans with a tall mean line and spacious terminal gaps, makes extended reading feel open and easy.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-armata: Wallpoet is a bold display face, smooth around every bend, with lowercase that rises high. And Armata, a sans with spacious gaps between characters and large lowercase bodies, lets text move along comfortably.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-athiti: Commanding Wallpoet curves smoothly, its lowercase rising high, with only low stroke contrast. Athiti, a plain sans, has none at all, cut like sign-shop vinyl at a single line width, which suits unhurried reading.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible: Loud on top, friendly below: Wallpoet rises high on smooth curves. Atkinson Hyperlegible, a sans with wide-set terminals on its s, is the one that does the approachable reading.
